dataset: Stanford Cars + local real cars and controls + 330 balanced color-labeled cars

questions.tem_carro: Is there a car in the image? Answer yes or no.
questions.marca: What is the make of the most prominent car?
questions.cor: What is the predominant color of the most prominent car?
questions.tipo: What body style is the most prominent vehicle?

laya.title: Ford F-450 Super Duty Crew Cab 2012

blip.title: Ford F-450 Super Duty Crew Cab 2012

note: All four base questions are sent to both models for every image. Only fields with ground-truth labels are scored. Every choice question has the same candidate count for Laya and BLIP.
